title: Sine Ratio
description: Calculates the ratio of the perpendicular side to the hypotenuse in a right triangle.

example.question: Find sin θ if the perpendicular is 6 cm and the hypotenuse is 10 cm.

title: Cosine Ratio
description: Calculates the ratio of the base to the hypotenuse in a right triangle.

example.question: Find cos θ if the base is 8 cm and the hypotenuse is 10 cm.

title: Tangent Ratio
description: Calculates the ratio of the perpendicular side to the base.

example.question: Find tan θ if the perpendicular is 12 cm and the base is 5 cm.

note: tan θ = sin θ / cos θ.

title: Cotangent Ratio
description: Calculates the ratio of the base to the perpendicular.

example.question: Find cot θ if the base is 9 cm and the perpendicular is 3 cm.

title: Secant Ratio
description: Calculates the ratio of the hypotenuse to the base.

example.question: Find sec θ if the hypotenuse is 15 cm and the base is 12 cm.

title: Cosecant Ratio
description: Calculates the ratio of the hypotenuse to the perpendicular.

example.question: Find cosec θ if the hypotenuse is 13 cm and the perpendicular is 5 cm.
